questions.q: The square root of a number is increased by $40\%$, and the result is 21. Find the original number. (CPO TIER I- \frac{12}{12}/2025-SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $40\%$ ka matlab $2/5$ hota hai. Yani base agar $5$ hai toh $2$ badhega. Seedha $7$ ka multiple check karna chahiye dimag me!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Root ko $40\%$ badhaya, yani $5$ unit se $7$ unit kar diya. Sawal cheekh cheekh ke keh raha hai ki naya root $21$ hai. Toh $7$ unit $= 21$, matlab $1$ unit $= 3$. Pucha kya hai? Original number! Pehle original root nikal, $5$ unit $= 15$. Ab is $15$ ka square phek ke maar, $225$ aayega. Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se jana hai toh maan le original number $x$ hai. Uska root $\sqrt{x}$ hai. Equation banegi: $\sqrt{x} \times (1 + \frac{40}{100}) = 21$. Yani $\sqrt{x} \times \frac{7}{5} = 21$. Solve karega toh $\sqrt{x} = 15$ aayega, fir square karke $x = 225$ milega. Par isme time waste hota hai bhai.

Exam Takeaway: Exam me jaldi baazi me 'original number' ki jagah root $15$ mat tick kar dena, pucha kya hai uspe focus karo!

ParameterCalculation
A. Base Shift1. $5 \to 7$
B. Real Value2. $7 \text{ units} = 21 \implies 5 \text{ units} = 15$

questions.q: In a city $40\%$ of the men are married and $25\%$ of women are married. Considering that nobody is married more than once. What percentage of population is married?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, shadi $1$ aadmi aur $1$ aurat ki hogi na? Toh married men aur married women barabar honge, direct M aur W ka ratio $25/40$ dikhna chahiye!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ninja technique dekh! $40\%$ of M $= 25\%$ of W. Ratio nikal $\frac{M}{W} = \frac{25}{40} = \frac{5}{8}$. Total population ban gayi $5+8 = 13$ units. Married aadmi nikale toh $5$ ka $40\%$ yani $2$ unit, aur aurtein bhi $2$ unit. Total married $= 4$ unit. Percentage pucha hai toh $\frac{4}{13} \times 100 = 30.76\%$. Approximation laga aur $30.8\%$ tick kar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le total log $x$ hain, par waha mat ja. Seedha ratio $5:8$ le kar values $500$ aur $800$ maan le. Married men $200$, married women $200$. Total $400$ shadi-shuda hain $1300$ me se. Fir percentage nikal $\frac{400}{1300} \times 100 = 30.76\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Jab values barabar bol di jayen, toh ratio seedha inverse ho jata hai, ratio pe khelo absolute values pe nahi!

Equate ConceptResulting Ratio
A. Married $M = W$1. $M : W = 5 : 8$

questions.q: In an examination, there were two papers, X and Y, and the maximum mark in each of the two papers was 20. However, the weights assigned to papers X and Y were in the ratio 3: 2, respectively. Rohan scored 18 out of 20 in Paper X and an overall $70\%$ in the examination. How much did he score in Paper Y out of 20?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, X me $90\%$ laaya hai ($18/20$), aur overall sirf $70\%$ chahiye. Matlab Y me definitely $70\%$ se kafi kam score aayega!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): JSM ka tagda use karenge yahan. X ka score hai $90\%$, aur target hai $70\%$. X kitna extra laya? $+20\%$. X ka weight $3$ hai, toh total extra hua $3 \times 20 = +60$. Ye $+60$ compensate karna padega Y ko jiska weight $2$ hai. Toh Y ka deviation aayega $-\frac{60}{2} = -30\%$. Y ko base $70\%$ se $30\%$ kam lana padega, yani $40\%$. Ab $20$ marks ka $40\%$ kitna hota hai? Seedha $8$!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average ka desi formula laga le. $\frac{W_1 \times S_1 + W_2 \times S_2}{W_1 + W_2} = \text{Overall}$. Yani $\frac{3 \times 90 + 2 \times Y}{5} = 70$. Equation solve karega toh $270 + 2Y = 350 \implies Y = 40\%$. Phir $20$ ka $40\%$ nikal.

Exam Takeaway: Average aur mixture ke questions me formula lagane se acha JSM (Deviation) lagao, calculations aadhi ho jayengi.

Paper (Weight)Deviation from 70%
A. X (Weight 3)1. $+20\% \times 3 = +60$
B. Y (Weight 2)2. Must be $-60$ ($-\frac{60}{2} = -30\%$)

questions.q: If $20\%$ of (P+Q) = $50\%$ of (P-Q), then find the ratio P:Q? (CGL TIER I - 17/09/2025 - Shift 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, percentage aur zero dono side baithe hain, seedha uda de. Dimag me hi $2(P+Q) = 5(P-Q)$ banna chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $2P + 2Q = 5P - 5Q$. Ab variables ek taraf kar le. $2Q$ ke paas $-5Q$ aayega toh $7Q$ banega. Aur $5P$ me se $2P$ gaya toh $3P$. Equation aayi $7Q = 3P$. Pucha kya hai? $P:Q$. Seedha palat de, $P:Q = 7:3$. Khel khatam!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Componendo and Dividendo laga sakta hai agar man kare. $\frac{P+Q}{P-Q} = \frac{5}{2}$. Phir $\frac{P}{Q} = \frac{5+2}{5-2} = \frac{7}{3}$. Ye bhi ek solid tarika hai concept build karne ka.

Exam Takeaway: CGL Tier 1 me aisi speed maintain karni padegi, step-by-step likhne me rank haath se nikal jayegi.

ExpressionSimplified Form
A. Left Hand Side1. $2(P+Q)$
B. Right Hand Side2. $5(P-Q)$

questions.q: P's monthly salary is 60,000. He spends $45\%$ of his monthly salary on food and $25\%$ of the remaining monthly salary on house rent. Additionally, he spends X on children's education and spends $15\%$ of his monthly salary on travel. If he saved his remaining salary and his savings is 12,000 then find the value of X?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 'remaining' aur 'monthly salary' keywords me fas gaya toh game over. Dhyan se dekh rent 'remaining' ka pucha hai, baki total ka!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Calculation dekho! Base salary $60$k. Food pe $45\%$ gaya yani $27$k. Bacha kitna? $33$k. Is bache hue ka $25\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{4}$) rent pe de diya $= 8250$. Travel par wapas total salary ka $15\%$ gaya yani $9000$. Total kharch $= 27000 + 8250 + 9000 = 44250$. Salary me se ye ghata toh $15750$ bacha. Usne $12000$ save kiye, matlab $15750 - 12000 = 3750$ bache, jo X (Education) ki value hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tree method bana le. Total $100$ maan le. Food $45$. Bacha $55$. Rent $55 \times \frac{1}{4} = 13.75$. Travel $15$. Total $45 + 13.75 + 15 = 73.75$. Remaining $26.25$ units. Value daalke percentage se multiply karega toh bhi same aayega par direct values lena yahan better tha kyunki $60$k asaan number hai.

Exam Takeaway: Question padhte waqt aankhein eagle jaisi honi chahiye, 'remaining' word jahan likha ho wahi game palat jata hai.

Expense AreaCalculated Value
A. Food & Travel1. Base Salary par
B. Rent2. Remaining par ($8250$)

questions.q: The price of rice falls by $35\%$. How much extra quantity of rice can be bought with the money that was sufficient to buy 104 kg of rice previously?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab paisa jeb me utna hi ho (amount constant) toh Price aur Consumption hamesha ulte chalte hain, inversely proportional!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR ka jaadu dekh. Price $35\%$ gira yani $100$ se $65$ hua. Ratio bana $20:13$. Toh Quantity ka ratio seedha ulta maro, $13:20$. Pehle $13$ unit aata tha, ab $20$ unit aayega. Purani quantity sawal me $104$ kg di hai. Yani $13$ unit $= 104$ kg $\implies 1$ unit $= 8$ kg. Pucha hai extra kitna aayega? Extra hai $7$ unit. Toh $7 \times 8 = 56$ kg. Bina mehnat ke done.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula lagao: Extra Quantity $= \frac{x}{100-x} \times \text{Old Quantity}$. Yani $\frac{35}{65} \times 104$. Kat-pit machao, $\frac{7}{13} \times 104 = 7 \times 8 = 56$ kg. Ye direct ratta fication wala method hai.

Exam Takeaway: CPR master kar liya toh Arithmetic me aadhe questions bina pen ke uda doge!

EntityRatio Shift
A. Price1. $20 \to 13$
B. Consumption2. $13 \to 20$ (Extra $7$)

questions.q: $\\frac{11}{5}$ of a number A is $22\\%$ of a number B. The number B is equal to $2.5\\%$ of a third number C. If the value of C is 5500, then the sum of $80\\%$ of A and $40\\%$ of B is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, C ki value aakhiri me di hai, toh peeche se attack karna start kar, aage se jaayega toh ulajh jayega!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse chalte hain! $C = 5500$. B uska $2.5\%$ hai. $2.5\%$ nikalne ke liye $\frac{1}{40}$ kar de, $5500 / 40 = 137.5$. Ab A aur B ka relation dekh: $\frac{11}{5} A = \frac{22}{100} B$. Yani $2.2A = 0.22B$, toh $A = 0.1B$. Toh A aagaya $13.75$. Ab pucha kya hai? $80\%$ of A ($11$) aur $40\%$ of B ($55$) ka sum. $11 + 55 = 66$. Khatak!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractions me khelna hai toh: A ka $\frac{11}{5} = B \times \frac{11}{50} \implies A = \frac{B}{10}$. Phir $B = 5500 \times \frac{1}{40}$. Raste wahi hain bas decimals se dar lagta ho toh fractions best hain.

Exam Takeaway: Jab values chain me hon aur last variable ki value given ho, backward approach lagaya karo.

StepCalculation
A. Find B1. $2.5\%$ of $5500 = 137.5$
B. Find A2. $A = 0.1B = 13.75$

questions.q: The population of town B is $300\%$ more than that of town A. For the next two years, the population of A increases by x% per year and that of B decreases by the same percentage per year. After 2 years, if the population of A and B become equal, then the value of x is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $300\%$ zyada ka matlab $4$ guna hota hai ($1:4$ ratio). Aur '2 years' sun ke seedha square root dimag me flash hona chahiye!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Equation banegi $A(1 + \frac{x}{100})^2 = B(1 - \frac{x}{100})^2$. B/A ki value $4$ hai. Dono taraf square root le le. Bacha $\frac{1 + x/100}{1 - x/100} = 2$. Cross multiply thok: $1 + \frac{x}{100} = 2 - \frac{2x}{100}$. Idhar udhar shift kar, $\frac{3x}{100} = 1 \implies x = 33\frac{1}{3}$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Option se try maar! Agar main $x = 33.33\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{3}$) lu. A badhega: $1 \times \frac{4}{3} \times \frac{4}{3} = \frac{16}{9}$. B ghatega: $4 \times \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{16}{9}$. Dekh dono barabar ho gaye na? Option checking is deadly here.

Exam Takeaway: Time duration hamesha power banata hai. 2 saal hai toh square, 3 saal ho toh cube ka logic lagana!

Power LogicTime Base
A. Square Root1. For 2 Years

questions.q: If m% of m + n% of n = $2\%$ of (m x n), then what percentage of m is n?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sawal me equation ghoor ke dekh, $m^2 + n^2 - 2mn = 0$ chupa hua hai isme, pure algebra ka khel hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Percentage ko denominator me daal: $\frac{m^2}{100} + \frac{n^2}{100} = \frac{2mn}{100}$. $100$ ko sab jagah se kaat de. Bacha $m^2 + n^2 - 2mn = 0$. Ye kya hota hai? $(m-n)^2 = 0$. Matlab $m = n$ ho gaya. Agar dono barabar hain toh 'n', 'm' ka pura $100\%$ hoga. Free ke 2 marks the ye!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Values rakh ke dekh le. Agar m = 10, n = 10 maane. Toh $10\%$ of $10 + 10\%$ of $10 = 1 + 1 = 2$. Aur RHS me $2\%$ of $100 = 2$. Match kar gaya. Toh 10, 10 ka kitna percent hai? $100\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic me algebra ghusa ke darane ki koshish hamesha fail hoti hai agar basics strong hon.

Algebra FormIdentity
A. Expanded1. $m^2 + n^2 - 2mn = 0$
B. Contracted2. $(m-n)^2 = 0 \implies m=n$

questions.q: In a class of 60 students, $40\%$ are girls. The average weight of boys is 62 kg and that of girls is 55 kg. What is the average weight of the whole class?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 60 students mazdoori karne ke liye diya hai. Total bacho se hume koi matlab nahi, sirf ratio se khelna hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Girls $40\%$ toh Boys $60\%$. Ratio Boys:Girls $= 3:2$. JSM method lagayenge. Maan le puri class ka average $55$ hai. Ab Boys ka average $62$ hai, yani $55$ se $7$ zyada. $3$ ladko pe total deviation aaya $+21$. Is total deviation ko total baccho ($3+2 = 5$) me baant de. $+21/5 = +4.2$. Base 55 me ye 4.2 jod de, final average $59.2$ kg. Pen-free hack!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average ka basic laga le. Total bacche $5$ unit hain. Total sum $= 3 \times 62 + 2 \times 55 = 186 + 110 = 296$. Average $= \frac{296}{5} = 59.2$ kg. Number chote the toh ye bhi jaldi ho jata.

Exam Takeaway: Absolute values tabhi use karni hain jab absolute answer pucha ho. Averages aur percentages hamesha ratio par nikal jate hain.

Deviation FlowCalculation
A. Base Assumed1. $55$ kg
B. Extra Share2. $\frac{21}{5} = 4.2$ kg

questions.q: In a mixture of 200 gms, quantity of water, spirit and alcohol is $20\%$, $30\%$ and $50\%$ respectively, $40\%$ of spirit from the mixture have been removed. If quantity of water is doubled then find the ratio of quantities in the mixture?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 3 items hain toh individually unka weight alag alag likh lene me hi bhalayi hai taki confusion na ho.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Shuru me Water $40$g, Spirit $60$g, Alcohol $100$g tha. Question kehta hai Spirit me se $40\%$ nikal diya. Yani $60$g ka $40\%$ ($24$g) gaya, toh Spirit bacha $36$g. Water ko double kiya yani $40$ se $80$ ho gaya. Alcohol wahi chupchap baitha hai $100$g. Naya ratio kya aaya? W:S:A $= 80 : 36 : 100$. Char ($4$) se kaat do sabko. $20 : 9 : 25$. Option C correct!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Percentages me direct khelne me galti ho sakti hai kyunki base total volume change ho raha hai. Isliye isme individual mass nikal kar ratio banana hi ekmatra safe concept builder hai.

Exam Takeaway: Aise questions me flow ke sath chalo. Jisme change bola hai wahi badlo, baki ko touch mat karna.

ComponentFinal State
A. Water1. Doubled ($80$g)
B. Spirit2. $-40\%$ ($36$g)

questions.q: A landlord bought a flat for Rs. 8,00,000. He wants to earn a $9\%$ annual return on his investment after paying Rs. 2,000 per month for maintenance. What should be the monthly rent he charges? (SSC CGL TIER I - \frac{12}{09}/2025 - Shift 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, return annual hai aur rent monthly pucha hai. Calculate yearly karke last me 12 se divide karna mat bhoolna!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bhai 8 lakh pe $9\%$ return chahiye, yani saal ka $\text{Rs. } 72,000$ pure profit aana chahiye landlord ko. Lekin society wale maintenance ka 2,000 mahina yani $24,000$ saal ka le lenge. Landlord ye apni jeb se nahi dega, kirayedar se vasulega! Toh total vasooli saal ki $72,000 + 24,000 = 96,000$. Har mahine ka kiraaya hua $\frac{96,000}{12} = \text{Rs. } 8,000$. Seedha common sense math hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation bana lo. Let monthly rent be R. $12R - 24000 = 9\%$ of $800000$. $12R - 24000 = 72000$. $12R = 96000$. $R = 8000$. School wala tarika yahi hai.

Exam Takeaway: Expense hamesha target income me add hota hai agar tumhe apna net profit maintain karna hai.

Finance LogicAnnual Value
A. Desired Return1. $72,000$
B. Total Collection2. $96,000$ (Return + Maint.)

questions.q: There are 2800 students in a school, out of which $75\%$ participate in a sport competition. Out of those who participate, $60\%$ are boys. $35\%$ of the boys and $25\%$ of the girls qualify for the final round of the competition. What percentage of the school will participate in the final round?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, question padhte hi 2800 ko kaat de dimag me. Percentage pucha hai toh 100 base maan kar fraction me hi rahenge!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total 100 bacche hain. $75$ ne participate kiya. Inme se $60\%$ ladke hain, toh $75$ ka $60\%$ ($3/5$) $= 45$ Boys. Bachi hui $30$ Girls hain. Qualify hone wale: Boys hain $45$ ka $35\%$ $= 15.75$. Girls hain $30$ ka $25\%$ (yani chauthayi) $= 7.5$. Total qualify kitne hue? $15.75 + 7.5 = 23.25$. Ye total 100 ka kitna percent hai? Seedha $23.25\%$ yani $23 \frac{1}{4}\!\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tree diagram. Participate: $3/4$. Boys: $3/5$ of $3/4 = 9/20$. Girls: $2/5$ of $3/4 = 3/10$. Qualified boys $= 35\%$ of $9/20 = \frac{63}{400}$. Qualified girls $= 25\%$ of $3/10 = \frac{3}{40}$. Total $= \frac{63+30}{400} = \frac{93}{400}$. Percentage nikalo $= \frac{93}{4} = 23.25\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Badi absolute values exam me bas tumhe fasane aur time kill karne ke liye hoti hain.

DistributionQualifier Units
A. Boys ($45$)1. $15.75$
B. Girls ($30$)2. $7.5$

questions.q: The base area of a prism is increased by $25\%$, while the height remains the same. By what percentage does the volume increase? (CGL TIER I - \frac{20}{09}/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Prism ki volume Base $\times$ Height hoti hai. Agar ek constant hai, toh dusra perfectly proportional hoga!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Formula dimag me laa: $V = A \times H$. Height constant hai, yani uska koi role nahi. Volume ab purely Base Area ka ghulam ban gaya. Agar Base Area $25\%$ badha, toh Volume bhi hase khushi $25\%$ badh jayegi! Bina pen ke 1 second me answer tick maar aur aage badh.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Proof chahiye? New $A = 1.25 A$. New $H = H$. New Volume $= 1.25A \times H = 1.25 V$. Yani seedha $25\%$ increase.

Exam Takeaway: Geometry ke questions me constants pe formula apply mat karna, directly directly unko uda dena chahiye!

Formula VariableImpact on Volume
A. Height1. Zero (Constant)
B. Base Area2. $100\%$ Direct correlation

questions.q: A man lost half of his initial amount in the gambling after playing 3 rounds. The rule of gambling is that if he wins he will receive Rs. 100, but he has to give $50\%$ of the total amount after each round. Luckily he won all the three rounds. The initial amount with which he had started the gambling was:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, conditions thodi complex hain toh aage se chalne me galti ho sakti hai. Standard equation banakar peeche se equate kar dena best rahega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, shuru me maan le X the. Round 1: X me 100 jeeta aur fir rule ke hisaab se adha dena pada, bacha $\frac{X+100}{2}$. Round 2: Phir 100 jeeta aur uska adha kiya toh $\frac{X+300}{4}$ bacha. Round 3: Fir 100 joda aur adha kiya toh $\frac{X+700}{8}$ bacha. Question cheekh raha hai ki 3 round ke baad initial ka adha bacha hai, yani $\frac{X}{2}$ bacha hai. Equate karde: $\frac{X+700}{8} = \frac{X}{2}$. Yahan se $X+700 = 4X \implies 3X = 700$. Toh X ki value aagayi $\frac{700}{3}$. Concept powerful hona chahiye bas!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se reverse khel lo. Par options fractions me hain toh thoda time jyada lag jayega. Isliye equation best thi.

Exam Takeaway: Jaha har round me naya operation ho, wahan variable man kar successive step likhna hi safe hota hai.

Gambling RoundAmount Remaining
A. Round 11. $\frac{X+100}{2}$
B. Round 3 (Final)2. $\frac{X+700}{8}$

questions.q: Some students (only boys and girls) from different schools appeared for an Olympiad exam. $40\%$ of the boys and $25\%$ of the girls failed the exam. The number of boys who passed the exam was 30 more than that of the girls who passed the exam. A total of 170 students failed. Find the number of students that appeared for the exam?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fail ki value total di hai, pass ki relative difference di hai. Do equations, do variable ka classical case hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Failed wali equation likh: $0.4B + 0.25G = 170$. Passed wali equation: $0.6B - 0.75G = 30$. Pehli equation me $3$ ka multiply maar de taki G barabar ho jaye: $1.2B + 0.75G = 510$. Ab isme passed wali jodd de, $+0.75G$ aur $-0.75G$ kat jayenge. Bacha $1.8B = 540$, yahan se $B = 300$ mil gaya. G ki value nikalne par $200$ aayegi. Total log $= 300 + 200 = 500$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se check karna ninja tactic hai. Agar total 500 ho, toh B=300 aur G=200 pe fit baithta hai kya dekh lo. Fail B=120, Fail G=50. Total fail 170 (Match!). Pass B=180, Pass G=150. Difference 30 (Match!). Option hi best hai bhai!

Exam Takeaway: Do variables wale word problems me equation banane me time lag raha ho, toh seedha options plug-in kar diya kar.

ConditionEquation Form
A. Failed Students1. $0.4B + 0.25G = 170$
B. Passed Difference2. $0.6B - 0.75G = 30$

questions.q: During a division, Pranjal mistakenly took as the dividend a number that was $10\%$ more than the original dividend. He also mistakenly took as the divisor a number that was $25\%$ more than the original divisor. If the correct quotient of the original division problem was 25 and the remainder was 0, what was the quotient that Pranjal obtained, assuming his calculations had no error?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Dividend numerator hai aur Divisor denominator. Dono me percentage change unka multiplier change kar dega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dividend $10\%$ badha yani $1.1$ guna ho gaya. Divisor $25\%$ badha yani $1.25$ guna ho gaya. Naya Quotient banega Purana Quotient $\times \frac{1.1}{1.25}$. Pura Quotient $25$ diya hai. Toh $25 \times \frac{110}{125} = 25 \times \frac{22}{25} = 22$. Bhai isme kuch tha hi nahi, seedha multiplication tha!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formally likhega toh: $Q = \frac{D}{d}$. Mistaken $Q' = \frac{1.1D}{1.25d} = \frac{1.1}{1.25} \times Q = \frac{1.1}{1.25} \times 25 = 22$.

Exam Takeaway: Fraction me upar neeche alag alag percentage lagna aam baat hai, multipliers ka concept clear rakho.

Term ChangeMultiplier
A. Dividend1. $1.1$ (Numerator)
B. Divisor2. $1.25$ (Denominator)

questions.q: In a family the ratio of expenditure to the savings was 7: 4. But their expenditure is increased by $42.84\%$ and income increased by only $20\%$ thus there is a deficit of Rs. 6448 in the savings. Find the increase in the income of the family.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $42.84\%$ dekhte hi pet me dard nahi hona chahiye. Ye $14.28\%$ (yani $1/7$) ka exactly 3 guna hai, yani $3/7$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le Exp $700$ aur Sav $400$ hai. Toh Income ho gayi $1100$. Expenditure $3/7$ badha, yani $700$ par $300$ badha, toh naya Exp $= 1000$.
